title: a project with no jitso/hard-rules/ folder launches with the hard-rules core and the reply style shipped inside the binary
source: intended: docs/architecture.md section 2 (hard-rules row) and docs/decisions.md (defect N-14): the embedded core is the default when a project has no jitso/hard-rules/
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-14, shipped hard-rules core and templates). When the project has no jitso/hard-rules/ folder, core.md of the launch folder is the core and the style that ship inside the binary, joined by one newline, and core_sha256 is the hash of that text.
